repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jS7jCv5PH4ytECQWqf

L1 REWORK · head `79bcf991d4f06f3c98ab9de95b96c43eeaa310fd` · 2026-11-22T12:51Z

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:从列表点开的右侧预览收到 460 宽,可拖 380 到 900;头部记录名优先,只留一个带文字的主要按钮,「编辑」「复制记录 ID」进「⋯」;子表页签一行一条。整页记录页不变。
- 为什么做:卡 #36149(右侧预览收紧)和 #36201(按钮把记录名挤成几个字),都属「记录详情页重做」专题。
- 出错会怎样:用户在预览里找不到某个按钮(都还在「⋯」里),或子表显示成卡片行。可以整体撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。
- 席位意见:REWORK,共 5 项。代码主体(头部一个动作、名字优先折叠、子表卡片行、复制入口)我读下来是对的,要补的是一页已发布文档、changeset 里两句不准、一处验收截图和一条测试钉。

## 要改的(5 项)

1. **已发布文档被本 PR 改成了错的。** `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-view.mdx:510-512` 写「The drawer is 720 px wide, and the reader can drag its edge from 360 px to 60% of the viewport」。本 PR 之后默认是 460,拖动范围是 380 到 900 px。按清单「本轮令其变假的已发布缺陷必修」,在本 PR 里改这一段。头部不再有「编辑」按钮和复制图标这件事,同节若要提也一并写上。

2. **changeset 和正文里「An object that authors its drawer size keeps it」不准。** 记住的宽度现在只有一个键(`RECORD_PREVIEW_WIDTH_KEY`),而 `navigation-overlay.tsx:566` 是 `resize.width != null` 时一律用记住的宽度,作者写的 `size` / `width` 让位。所以读者在任何一个对象的预览里拖过一次,写了 `size: 'xl'` 的对象下次打开也是那个拖出来的宽度。以前键是按对象分的,只有拖过这个对象本身才会盖掉。二选一:改这句话,写明「拖过一次后,作者写的尺寸也让位于拖出的宽度」;或者对写了 `size` / `width` 的对象不用共享键。选哪种由区域定,但 changeset 必须和代码一致。

3. **拖动范围的变化不只在右侧预览,changeset 没写。** `DRAWER_MIN_PX` / `DRAWER_MAX_PX` 在 `@object-ui/components` 的 `NavigationOverlay` 里,所有带 `storageKey` 的抽屉都受影响:`plugin-calendar` 的 `ObjectCalendar.tsx:1670`、`plugin-gantt` 的 `ObjectGantt.tsx:2436`、`plugin-detail` 的 `RecordDetailDrawer.tsx:156`、`plugin-grid` 的 `ObjectGrid.tsx:3929`。具体是:1920 宽的窗口里,上限从 60vw(1152)降到 900;记住的 360 到 379 不再沿用。这是有意的就在 changeset 的 `@object-ui/components` 段写一句;不是有意的就只对预览收窄。

4. **#36201 的验收截图没有按卡给,也没说为什么换。** 卡的验收写「PR 正文附 HotCRM 线索预览头部的改动前后截图」(Mira Costa - Atlas Construction)。正文用的是 app-todo 的任务(5 个动作)。在 Acceptance notes 里补 HotCRM 线索的前后截图,或者写明换成 app-todo 的原因,并说明它证明了同一件事(全名可读、只一个带文字按钮、其余在「⋯」)。同一处再写一句:#36201 验收里的「没有自定义动作的记录,头部和现在一样」被 #36149 盖过了(「编辑」和复制图标都去掉了),这是两卡合做的结果,不是漏改。

5. **「一个宽度管所有对象」没有测试钉住。** #36149 验收「关掉再打开另一条,宽度是上次拖的」靠的是 `objectViewRecordOverlay.tsx:80` 和 `recordDrawerStack.tsx:973` 都传 `RECORD_PREVIEW_WIDTH_KEY`。现在把这两处改回 `drawer-width:${objectName}`,没有一个测试会红:`navigation-overlay-drawer-27545` 用的是固定的 `drawer-width:lead`。在 app-shell 补一条:对象 A 的预览里拖出的宽度(或写进 `ov:` + 这个键的值),对象 B 的预览打开时用上。正文写这条测试的消融读数。

## 不阻塞,顺手可做

- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json:1731` 写「a ~720 px record DRAWER」,也过时了。它不发布,顺手改成 460 即可。
- 范围外:spec 里 `navigation.size` 的说明「'auto' (default — renderer derives from field count + viewport)」自 #27545 起就不对了(auto 是固定默认宽)。本 PR 没碰它,不在这里修,席位可以立卡。

## 席位核对

- **卡片关系**:首行 `Fixes #36149`,正文还有 `Fixes #36201`。两卡都是本 PR 交付的(#36201 第 1–4 条:名字优先、只一个带文字动作且加宽也不变多、截断有全名提示、整页不变),所以两个 `Fixes` 都应当关卡,l1-face 的 keywords-other-cards 旗是有意的。前置 #36147 已关。
- **Clause-②: yes (widening)**:三个新的可选成员 `RecordHeaderBar.preview`、`PageHeaderActionsProps.preview`、`ObjectGridComponentProps.cardFace`,没有删改。`RECORD_PREVIEW_DEFAULT_WIDTH` / `RECORD_PREVIEW_WIDTH_KEY` 在 app-shell 的 `recordDrawerContext.ts`,`git grep` 不在包根导出,不扩大公开面。声明对。`Metadata-protocol: none` 对,Skills-docs 不欠。不是 `!`,也没有 `(narrowing)`,dogfood 不欠。
- **changeset**:四个包(components、plugin-grid、plugin-detail、app-shell)都有 patch 条目。逐句核过:Width 段第 2 句「An object that authors its drawer size keeps it」见第 2 项;Header 段与 `containers.tsx` 的 `previewRow` / `previewPick` / `hostKeepsRow` 和 `previewNameSqueezed` 一致;Child tabs 段与 `RelatedList.tsx` 的 `previewFace` 和 `ObjectGrid.tsx` 的 `useCardView = windowCardView || !!hostCardFace` 一致。
- **第 5 条「更多 N」**:#35595(已关)裁定页签只按宽度收进下拉,对所有界面适用。正文写明了席位裁定,不建横向滑动,接受。
- **第 7、8 条已在主干成立**:正文附了在同一预览里打开子记录、返回后页签保留的实测截图,接受。返回入口的写法沿用 #26679 的路径,正文已写明。
- **测试**:头部预览栏新用例带对照(名字有空间时保留动作、整页栏保留复制图标且不按名字折叠、审批的通过 / 拒绝照画);`cardFaceHost-36149` 有 1440 无 `cardFace` 和 390 两个对照,消融去掉 `hostCardFace` 后对应用例红、复原后 blob 等于 HEAD。`RelatedList.previewCardFace-36149` 有三个反向对照。
- **CI @ `79bcf991`**:47 success、15 skipped、0 failed;mergeable clean;不在治理面。

repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `79bcf991d4f06f3c98ab9de95b96c43eeaa310fd`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read: card #36149 body and every comment (triage, seat hold, coordinator note 7073032439, claim, os-dev-report 7079073391, claim amendment 7079104853). Card #36201 body and every comment (triage, dispatch, fold hold 7072664137, claim, claim amendment 7079110806). PR #36438 body and its one comment 7079342262. The net diff from merge base `ff60149900` to the head: 19 files, +672 / -84. The check-runs on the head.

### ① Derived judgments

No accept-set change. The diff touches no `packages/spec` file, no schema and no governed path. The spec's record surface (`packages/spec/src/data/record-surface.ts`) leaves an `auto` size to the renderer, so the new 460 default is not a changed meaning of authored metadata.

Public surface, judged from the built entry points (`ui/packages/components/src/index.ts`, `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/index.tsx`):

- `RecordHeaderBar.preview` (`@object-ui/components`, exported type). New optional member. Absent means a page bar, as before. Named right.
- `PageHeaderActionsProps.preview` (`@object-ui/components`, exported type). New optional member, default `false`. With it off, the row and fold are unchanged: the new fold list `ranked` minus host minus inline is the same set, in the same order, as the old `authoredButtons.slice(rowBudget)`. `hostKeepsRow` reduces to `isHostButton`. The layout effect reduces to the old wrap test. Named right.
- `ObjectGridComponentProps.cardFace` (`@object-ui/plugin-grid`, exported type). New optional host prop. The `object-grid` renderer passes `schema` apart from host props, so authored metadata cannot set it. Absent means card rows below 768 px only, as before. Named right.
- `NavigationOverlay` (`@object-ui/components`, exported through `./custom`). No prop type changed, but the drag range of the existing `storageKey` behaviour changed for every caller. See S1. Not named in the declaration.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`. Its new constants `RECORD_PREVIEW_DEFAULT_WIDTH` and `RECORD_PREVIEW_WIDTH_KEY`, the `RECORD_DRAWER_WIDTH` value 720 to 460, and the `sys_copy_record_id` menu entry are not on a published surface. Named right as internal.
- i18n: the copy entry uses the existing keys `detail.copyRecordId` and `detail.copied`. No new key.

PR body claims checked against the code. These hold: the one labelled action is the first authored `variant: 'primary'`, else the first authored action, never a host or destructive one. In the host's edit state only Cancel and Save stay. The 16 em name floor is measured in `previewNameSqueezed`. The name has a `title` tooltip. The copy icon is hidden only when the bar is a preview. The copy entry is preview only. Approval levers are untouched. `cardFace` is handed only on an enlarged tab under a preview bar. The default width is `min(92vw, 460px)`. The ResizeObserver clears the cap on a host width change, so the primary can return when the name then fits. One claim does not hold as written: "An object that authors its drawer size keeps it". See S2.

### ② Semver level

The changeset `.changeset/36149-side-preview-tighten.md` lists `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, `@object-ui/plugin-detail` and `@object-ui/app-shell`, each `patch`. These are exactly the four packages the diff moves. Under AGENTS.md (Land it, item 3) a `Metadata-protocol: none` change ships `patch`, widening included. Both `Check Changeset` runs on the head are success.

`Clause-②: yes (widening)` is right. The three new optional members are the only type-level additions. Nothing is removed or renamed. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right. Both lines are line-initial in the PR body and the changeset body. They match the claim amendments on #36149 and #36201. The S1 change does not move either line, because it changes no type and no accept-set, but the declaration prose should name it.

### ③ Boundary flags

- open_questions, #36149 item 5 (tab overflow). Answered. The seat ruled option A: the preview ships 「更多 N」 as #35595 rules for every face. The PR body says so twice (维护者速读 last line, and Acceptance notes item 5, "The seat confirmed this reading; no swipe is built"). The final head comment 7079342262 repeats it. No swipe code is in the diff.
- `Fixes #36149` and `Fixes #36201`. Right. Items 7 and 8 were measured already true on `main`: `RecordStackDrawer` draws one `NavigationOverlay` over a level stack, with `onBack` and the trail. The PR says it did not rebuild them. Item 2's comment part is owned by #36225, and PR #36406 for it merged at 11:40Z. Once this PR lands, both cards' acceptance holds on `main`, except the HotCRM evidence named in S3.
- Card premise correction. The card guessed the preview stacks a second drawer. The dev measured that it does not. Recorded in the report and the body.
- Coordinator note 7073032439 item 2 (shared or per-object width). The PR adopts one shared width and says why. See S2 for one effect of that choice.
- Dev deviations (first push before overlap-check, one early run with two workers, the changeset regrade from minor to patch). All disclosed. The regrade is correct.
- Note, not graded. The body says the comment icon stays until #36406 lands. #36406 is now on `main` but not in this head, whose last main merge is `ff60149900` (10:24Z). It edits three of the same files (`RecordDetailView.tsx`, `recordDrawerContext.ts`, `recordDrawerStack.tsx`). GitHub reports the PR mergeable and clean. The main sync before landing is the area's job, as comment 7079342262 says.
- SQL push-down. No new data read, no id materialisation and no in-app join. The card face draws the rows the tab already loads.
- Check-runs on the head. Every run is success or an expected skip. None failed.
- Security. None found.

S1 (should-fix) — The drag range change reaches every resizable record overlay, and the declaration names it only for the side preview. `DRAWER_MIN_PX` and `DRAWER_MAX_PX` in `ui/packages/components/src/custom/navigation-overlay.tsx` are component-wide. So `ObjectCalendar`, `ObjectGantt`, `ObjectKanban`, `ObjectTree`, `ObjectGrid`'s own overlay and `RecordDetailDrawer` with `resizable` also change from 360 px to 60vw, to 380 to 900 px. A remembered width from 360 to 379 px is now dropped. On a 1920 px window the widest drag falls from 1152 to 900 px. On a 1024 px window it rises from 614 to 900 px, because the `60vw` clamp on a remembered width is gone. The changeset and PR body describe the range only for "the record preview". The Clause-② reason says "new optional members only". Fix: name the component-wide range change in the changeset and the PR body, or scope the range to the preview's host.

S2 (should-fix) — One shared remembered width overrides an authored drawer width on other objects, so the claim "An object that authors its drawer size keeps it" holds only until the reader drags any preview. In `NavigationOverlay` a remembered width wins over the host's `width`. Before, the key was per object, so only a drag on that object replaced its authored `navigation.size` or `navigation.width`. Now `RECORD_PREVIEW_WIDTH_KEY` is shared, so a drag on one object's preview resizes every object's preview, authored ones included. A side effect: the console preview and the calendar, gantt and kanban overlays of the same object no longer share one width. The published helper `recordOverlayWidthStorageKey` still says they do. Fix: qualify the claim in the changeset and PR body, or keep an authored width out of the shared key. Then correct the helper's jsdoc.

S3 (should-fix) — #36201's acceptance names a HotCRM scenario, and the PR body shows a different one without saying so. The card asks for before and after screenshots of the HotCRM lead Mira Costa's preview header, with the full name 「Mira Costa - Atlas Construction」 readable. The body shows an app-todo task with five actions instead and does not call it a substitute. Fix: add the HotCRM lead screenshots, or state the substitution and why, before `Fixes #36201` closes the card.

Reviewed-by: `session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC`

**VERDICT: PASS**

repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jS7jCv5PH4ytECQWqf

L1 REWORK(增量)· head `88832eb274e3f1d8c2e129beea468f4cdb97d7f3` · 2026-11-22T17:22Z

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:和上一轮一样。从列表点开的右侧预览默认 460 宽,可拖 380 到 900。头部记录名优先,只留一个带文字的主要按钮,「编辑」「复制记录 ID」进「⋯」。子表页签一行一条。这一轮新加了一点:对象自己写了抽屉尺寸的,预览按作者写的宽度打开,不被别的对象拖出的宽度盖掉。
- 为什么做:卡 #36149 和 #36201。这一轮是对我的 REWORK 7079404899 的修改。
- 出错会怎样:和上一轮一样,可以整体撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。
- 席位意见:REWORK,只有 1 项,只改文字(changeset 一句和已发布文档一句),不动代码。上一轮的 5 项都改了,代码和新测试我读下来是对的。

## 要改的(1 项)

1. **「写了宽度的对象只记住在它自己预览里拖出的宽度」不准,而且 changeset 紧接的一句把范围说大了。** 这句话在两处:
   - changeset Width 段:「its preview opens at the authored width and remembers only a width dragged in its own preview, under its per-object key. So the console's preview no longer shares a width with the same object's calendar, gantt, kanban, tree or grid overlay, which keep the per-object key」;
   - 已发布的 `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-view.mdx:512-516`:「that drawer opens at the authored width and remembers only a width dragged in its own drawer」。

   代码是这样的:写了宽度的对象,`recordPreviewWidthKey` 返回 `recordOverlayWidthStorageKey(objectName)`,也就是 `drawer-width:OBJECT`。这个键 `ObjectCalendar.tsx:1670`、`ObjectGantt.tsx:2436`、`ObjectKanban.tsx:2054`、`ObjectTree.tsx:1254`、`ObjectGrid.tsx:4068`、`RecordDetailDrawer.tsx:156` 都在用。所以读者在这个对象的日历或看板浮层里拖过宽度,预览打开时也是那个宽度,不是「只记住在它自己预览里拖出的」。「So … no longer shares a width with the same object's calendar …」也只对没写宽度的对象成立。写了宽度的对象和以前一样,和那几个浮层共用一个宽度。

   请把两处改成和代码一致,例如:「写了宽度的对象沿用它按对象的键(和这个对象的日历、甘特、看板、树、表格浮层共用),拖过之前按作者写的宽度打开」;「不再和同一对象的浮层共用宽度」限定为没写宽度的对象。同一句里的「a pixel `navigation.width`」也顺手改掉:代码看的是 `nav.width != null`,而 spec 里 `navigation.width` 是字符串或数字(`view.zod.ts:3046`,「Pixel/percent width」),所以写百分比也算作者写了。只改文字;如果区域更想让代码只认像素宽度,那就改代码,但两边要一致。

## 增量核对(`79bcf991` → `88832eb2`:返工提交 `d8900963`,其余是合入 main,含 #36514)
